# Arjun Bhadra

> Software engineer building applied AI systems: LLM pipelines, agentic apps and the developer tools around them. Senior Software Engineer, AI/ML Applications at Adobe (GenStudio). Before that, eight years building Adobe's mobile and TV SDKs (Android, iOS, JavaScript, Roku, Amazon Vega OS). San Francisco Bay Area.

This file is a plain-text summary of https://arjunbhadra.com for AI agents and crawlers. The site itself renders its project details with JavaScript.

## Contact
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/arjunbhadra/
- GitHub: https://github.com/addb

## Focus
Applied AI, LLM systems, agentic workflows (tool calling, multi-model orchestration), developer tooling with coding agents, and cross-platform SDKs.

## About
A builder at heart who loves to experiment. With AI in the toolbox, building things has never been easier; the part that still keeps him hooked is turning experiments into something people can rely on. Away from the keyboard: model cars, photography and chess.

## Current systems
The site's demos are illustrations of these systems, not live production data.

### The GenAI service behind Adobe GenStudio (2025–now)
An enterprise pipeline that turns campaign inputs into on-brand ad copy and assets for big brands.
- Role: Senior Software Engineer, AI/ML Applications
- Where: Adobe
- Since: 2025
- Stack: Python, async services
- Context first, then generate: Brand, product and audience context is gathered before any copy is written, so every variant starts from the brand rather than a blank prompt.
- Brand-safety checks: Every output is post-processed for brand safety before it reaches a campaign.
- Routing across providers: Requests are routed across model providers, including Azure OpenAI.
- Bring your own model: Integrations that let enterprises run generation on their own hosted models, designed directly with customer engineering teams.
- Shared, pluggable pipelines: The service was reshaped into shared pipelines, so new channels and models plug in with little code and no repeated boilerplate.
- Page: https://arjunbhadra.com/#genstudio-service

### Layers
An AI agent composes a scene layer by layer, or splits a flat image into editable layers; either way you can export it back to an image or turn it into a video.
- Built: End to end
- Status: Deployed
- Agent: Claude tool calling
- Quality: Regression eval harness
- The agent loop: A custom Claude tool-calling agent decides which tool to call next, from segmentation to image models to compositing.
- Segmentation and image models: SAM2 finds the pieces; Gemini image models handle the pixels.
- Video from elements: Veo turns a composition’s elements into video.
- Regression evals: A regression eval harness keeps the image pipeline honest as prompts and models change.
- End to end: Built and deployed by Arjun, from the agent loop to production.
- Page: https://arjunbhadra.com/#layers

### OmniGen (2025)
An agentic ad-generation prototype: an agent plans the ad, then produces a set of variants, each with its own copy, image and video.
- Event: Adobe hackathon
- Year: 2025
- Type: Agentic prototype
- Output: Copy, image, video
- Plan first: A planning agent reads the brief and decides the audience and message before anything is generated.
- One brief, three outputs: Copy, a hero image and a short video come from the same plan.
- Page: https://arjunbhadra.com/#omnigen

### Coding-agent skills
Repository-aware Claude Code skills and a shared wiki for debugging, code review and onboarding, now part of the daily routine on two teams.
- Built on: Claude Code custom skills
- Adopted by: Two teams
- Used for: Debugging, review, onboarding
- Debugging: Skills that know the repository and how it fails.
- Code review: A consistent first pass before a human looks.
- Onboarding: Shared wiki knowledge new engineers can ask.
- Two teams: Adopted by engineers on Arjun’s team and on an adjacent model-gateway team.
- Page: https://arjunbhadra.com/#coding-agent-skills

### Adobe’s mobile and TV SDKs (2017–2025)
The plugin-based Mobile SDK for iOS and Android, and data-collection SDKs for Roku and Amazon Vega OS (Fire TV). Code that runs on millions of devices.
- Years: 2017 to 2025
- Role: Software Engineer, Mobile
- Platforms: iOS, Android, Roku, Vega OS
- Status: Open source
- Two new TV platforms: Built Adobe’s data-collection SDKs for Roku and Amazon Vega OS (Fire TV), from architecture through release.
- iOS and Android: Shipped the plugin-based Mobile SDK for data collection and media analytics on both platforms.
- Validation tooling: Test automation, validator apps and cross-version compatibility suites.
- Open source: Contributed to the open-source Mobile SDK.
- Mentoring: Mentored a junior engineer on SDK architecture and design decisions.
- Page: https://arjunbhadra.com/#mobile-sdk

### Voyager
An internal workbench of AI tools and utilities: API and load testing for the GenStudio generation service, plus LLM tools like an LLM council and side-by-side model comparison. Every tool keeps a run history and exports reports.
- Type: Internal workbench
- Testing: API and load tests for the GenStudio service
- LLM tools: LLM council, model comparison
- Every run: History and exportable reports
- API testing: Exercise the GenStudio generation service's APIs from one place.
- Load testing: Put the same APIs under concurrent load and watch how they hold up.
- LLM council: Bring several models to the same question and weigh their answers together.
- Model comparison: Run one prompt across models side by side.
- History and reports: Each tool and utility keeps its run history, and any run can be exported as a report.
- Page: https://arjunbhadra.com/#voyager

### SnappLock (2014)
“An App Locker, With a Difference. When you can protect your data, you are safe. But when you get to catch the thief, it’s fun!”
- Platform: Android
- Downloads: 5K+ on Google Play
- Paper: IJCA 104(16)
- Status: Free, later open source
- Intruder ID: A wrong passcode captures a front-camera image of whoever tried.
- Three strikes: After three wrong passcodes, a text goes to a number you choose and an alert tone plays.
- Relock policy: Unlock all apps for a set period, then relock.
- Auto-start: Protection comes back on by itself after a reboot.
- The paper: Co-authored the related paper in IJCA 104(16).
- Links: [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/addb/SnappLock-An-Android-Application-Locker)
- Page: https://arjunbhadra.com/#snapplock

### ABC3D (2015)
An AR literacy game in two modes: scan a letter and a 3D object pops up, then drive a toy car around a little world collecting things that start with that letter.
- Built with: Unity, Vuforia
- Year: 2015
- Paper: IEEE PerCom Workshops 2016
- Role: Co-developed
- Mode 1: scan a letter: The camera recognizes an alphabet marker and shows a 3D object for it: A for apple.
- Mode 2: drive and collect: Children collect a set number of objects that start with the letter, in a bounded little world. Things that start with other letters don’t count.
- The paper: Co-authored the IEEE PerCom Workshops 2016 paper.
- Co-developed: A team project built with Unity and Vuforia.
- Links: [Read the paper (PDF)](https://ics.uci.edu/~kobsa/papers/2016-PerCom-ABC3D-Kobsa.pdf)
- Page: https://arjunbhadra.com/#abc3d

### Intelligent Business Analytics (2015)
A gadget portal with descriptions, specs, best-buy prices and comparisons, plus a Twitter trend view that classifies tweets with a Naive Bayes classifier.
- Year: 2015
- Type: B.E. final-year project
- Where: VESIT, University of Mumbai
- Model: Naive Bayes
- The portal: Gadget descriptions, specs, best-buy prices and comparisons in one place.
- Naive Bayes on tweets: Tweets with a gadget’s hashtag are classified as positive, negative or neutral.
- Final-year project: B.E. in Information Technology, VESIT, University of Mumbai.
- Page: https://arjunbhadra.com/#intelligent-business-analytics
